key_insight: Conditional thermal states offer a route to improved quantum thermometry and were prepared on few-qubit IonQ hardware across a range of temperatures.
engineering_relevance: Preparing these states on gate-based quantum hardware supports practical exploration of precision thermometry and quantum thermodynamics.
method: Condition thermal states on an accessible measurement pointer basis.
Prepare few-qubit conditional thermal states on IonQ cloud quantum computers.
Measure sub-quantum Fisher information using a constant-depth circuit without tomography.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports hardware preparation across multiple temperatures and measurement of a lower bound on quantum Fisher information to evaluate thermometric performance.
watch_item: The demonstration is limited to few-qubit systems, and the abstract does not quantify the thermometric advantage or scalability under hardware noise.
paper_title: NISQ Preparation of Conditional Thermal States for Precision Thermometry
